entry_points.text: Guest dump file opens by pinning VM and allocating parser, shows by walking full intermediate range with leaf-only visitation and flushing, and companion files report address bits and level counts as decimal.
Breakpoint and watchpoint traps resolve encoding to per-vCPU storage, apply masked field access and mark guest ownership; userspace views access whole words with invalid argument on missing storage.

Control access gates then updates writable bits preserving others; identification access is read-only returning filtered monitor words; counter and type accesses decode index, gate, validate and delegate to monitor helpers.

Enable-class registers share set and clear views with masked OR and AND-complement updates triggering reprogramming; information reads expose slots; software increment masks and delegates; timer control clears latched status and count installs offsets.

Identifier and cache traps reject read-only writes and return stored values; stack and exception traps move value words; nested SVE traps inject when enabled; interrupt version registers are read-only; implementation identifiers support VM-scoped writable mode.

exports.text: Guest PMU capability query returns filtered half word by selector with lower base zero and upper base thirty-two plus filter bytes at sixteen thousand offset; per-CPU accumulation tracks host and guest wants; user-enable propagation updates trap state.
Software interrupt distribution fans a sender request to selected recipients, honoring broadcast versus affinity list targeting and caller group permission.

Identification descriptor factories and the system register table bind trap, reset, storage, user and visibility handlers per class across debug, control, translation, fault, performance and identification spaces.
Shared helpers derive multiprocessor affinity from vCPU id with bit thirty-one set, and install a poison default for unknown registers after slot checks.

hazards.text: Invalid start levels and unexpected directions warn once; allocation exhaustion and VM pin failures abort opens with errors without leaking references.

Unresolvable debug storage marks VM buggy preventing ever running, with trap failing and reset returning zero; invalid slots, direct decode errors and read-only writes trigger bug checks indicating host errors.

Feature validation oversize maps to invalid argument; legacy encodings are silently rewritten so observed values differ without error; zero-visibility registers still read zero; mismatched post-run writes report busy.

Out-of-range performance partition writes clamp silently; misdirected nested traps report as bad traps; identifier, tagging and control paths depend on external bitfield, mask, mutex and bug helpers owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Capability halves pair host common and extended bitmaps into sixty-four bits; lower half forces software increment and chain bits, upper half suppresses stall events without strict virtualization, further masked by VM filter bytes.

Event tracking need follows PMU version and host versus guest exclusion; accumulation adds only included sides; user-enable store needs version, host extensions and running on-CPU vCPU; resync needs interrupt context.

Monitor resets narrow a poisoned word to implemented counters plus cycle handling; visibility gates monitor and authentication keys on features; enable, interrupt-enable and overflow share one word with set and clear views.

Debug demultiplexing selects breakpoint value, breakpoint control, watchpoint value or watchpoint control arrays by class with row as index; partial accesses mask and shift, preserving unselected bits on write and right-aligning on read.

Identifier writes validate field by field against reset limits with lower-is-safer for debug and performance; sanitised reads yield zero when so visible, otherwise host state narrowed for authentication, timer, vector, overlay and speculation fields.

Vector and thirty-two-bit identifiers report zero without support while other extensions hide; legacy debug and performance encodings are normalized before validation; cache level reset synthesizes coherent topology plus tagging at top.

Identification entries default to common access, user and visibility handlers varying only base mask, with hidden forms forcing zero visibility; EL2 wrapper defers to feature predicates when EL2 gate fails; guest VTR masks host value.

Interrupt sender traps need controller version three and write direction, decoding group from opcode; dispatch broadcasts or rebuilds affinity from three levels plus target list with MPIDR lookup; status reads return fixed values.

Cache maintenance traps accept only writes and flag way flush without firmware coherency; virtual memory controls merge partial writes preserving untouched bits and reevaluate cache enablement against prior state.

locks.text: Guest page-table display holds the VM memory management lock in write mode across walk and flush, serializing against concurrent table mutation.
Interrupt queueing and private enable updates serialize per-interrupt state with a raw spinlock with interrupts saved across group checks, pending, enable and host injection.

Userspace updates to slots, identifiers and implementation identifiers serialize on the VM configuration mutex across validate and store, enforcing pre-run mutability and rejecting out-of-range or changed-after-run values.

state_machines.text: Trap handlers signal handled with true and undefined with false; direction mismatches warn once and inject undefined; zero-read helper returns zero.
Dump session moves from allocation through level setup to locked display; allocation or pin failures release prior resources with errors, successful display always flushes output.

Interrupt queueing drops requests failing group permission, latches pending and joins virtual queue for software interrupts or asks host for hardware-backed, always releasing reference; monitor user access gates by operation class or privileged mode with undefined on denial, and counter validation allows cycle index regardless of count.

VM identifiers are mutable before first run with locked validate and store, immutable after with lock-free reads and writes succeeding only on equality; timer traps map encodings to instances with hyp redirection, and RAS traps gate subsets on version before zero behavior.

structs.text: Guest dump state bundles second-stage pointer, parser, two address markers and one descriptor per level sized by maximum levels; marker array has two entries; display maps validity, permissions, execute combinations, access flag and block versus page to short tags.

Register descriptors carry encoding, trap, reset, slot, user, visibility and base; trap exchange carries direction plus value; placement flags distinguish memory, loaded, mapped, translated width and special handling; debug state has four indexed arrays.

Affinity packs vCPU id into four plus eight plus eight bits with bit thirty-one set; unknown reset installs 0x1de7ec7edbadc0de; cache selector bound is fourteen; SCTLR reset seeds 0x00C50078; MIDR mask covers low thirty-two bits.
